 Donald Glover is teaming up with Netflix for a new live-action video game adaptation.

 In recent years, there have been several video games adapted for the screen , including Sonic the Hedgehog , The Last of Us , Fallout , Mario , Minecraft, and Mortal Kombat . The trend isn't slowing down anytime soon, with The Legend of Zelda , Call of Duty, and many more in the works, including at Netflix with Assassin's Creed , Gears of War and others.
 Now the popular streamer can add another one to that list, as Deadline is reporting that Glover has signed on as director, lead star, writer and executive producer of a TV show based on Krafton's hit video game PUBG .
 His brother, Stephen Glover, is also serving as an executive producer, along with Michael Schaefer, Taeseok, Fam Udeorji, and Sujin Lee. The Neon-produced project is moving forward as a result of Netflix's new first-look partnership with Krafton.
 PUBG , which stands for PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds , launched in 2017. With over 75 million copies sold, it became one of the most popular video games of all time, alongside the likes of Minecraft , Grand Theft Auto , Mario Kart , The Elder Scrolls, and The Witcher .
 After it was initially available on PC and Xbox One platforms, PUBG eventually expanded to mobile devices and transitioned to a free-to-play model in 2022. The video game also has several Guinness World Records and won Best Multiplayer Game at The Game Awards in 2017.
 There were initially plans to develop PUBG as an animated TV show, spearheaded by Adi Shankar, but nothing ever materialized, and it appears that Netflix's live-action adaptation has replaced that series.

 Glover is taking on multiple roles on Netflix's PUBG . This isn't the first time the actor and singer has had such a large involvement in a TV show. In 2024, he co-created Prime Video's Mr. & Mrs. Smith reboot with Francesca Sloane and starred as the titular John Smith alongside Maya Erskine's Jane Smith.
 A reimagining of Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie's 2005 film, Mr. & Mrs. Smith earned positive reviews from critics, who gave it a 90% on Rotten Tomatoes, and had one of the biggest premieres ever for Prime Video.
 During awards season, the show received 16 Emmy nominations, with Michaela Coel winning for Outstanding Guest Actress in a Drama Series and Stephen Pope winning for stunt coordination. Production on Mr. & Mrs. Smith season 2 began earlier this year.
 Before that, Glover was best known for his roles on Community and Atlanta , the latter of which he also created. Atlanta was showered with universal acclaim throughout its four-season run and won multiple Emmys and Golden Globes, and even a Peabody. He also co-created the Emmy-nominated Prime Video series Swarm .

 Donald Glover has a first-look contract with Amazon MGM Studios, but the current terms of the deal permit him to work on projects elsewhere, which is why he's able to produce the upcoming PUBG adaptation for Netflix. So far, he's the only cast member who's been announced, and a production timeline and release date are not known at this time.
